title: BiLoCo: Binary Low-Rank Corrections for Post-Training Quantization
abstract: arXiv:2610.32243v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Post-training quantization (PTQ) to FP4 has emerged as a key technique for reducing large language model inference cost, especially on Blackwell GPUs, which offer native FP4 tensor core support. Direct PTQ to FP4, however, still leaves a noticeable accuracy gap. Recent work on SVDQuant mitigates the errors introduced through FP4 quantization for diffusion models by adding high-precision low-rank corrections obtained via SVD. However, this high-precision low-rank correction requires many bits per rank, and it runs on the same tensor cores as the main FP4 GEMM. We introduce BiLoCo, a low-rank correction method whose left and right factors are stored as binary ${\{\pm 1\}}$ sign vectors rather than as BF16 numbers. The signed format uses $16{\times}$ less storage per rank-one component, and since the correction now consists of additions/subtractions, this can be run on CUDA cores concurrently with the FP4 tensor-core GEMM. translated_title: BiLoCo：用于训练后量化的二值低秩校正
translated_abstract: 将大语言模型训练后量化（PTQ）至FP4已成为降低推理成本的关键技术，尤其是在提供原生FP4张量核心支持的Blackwell GPU上。然而，直接进行FP4训练后量化仍会留下明显的精度差距。近期SVDQuant的工作通过添加经由SVD获得的高精度低秩校正，缓解了FP4量化对扩散模型造成的误差。然而，这种高精度低秩校正每个秩需要消耗大量比特，且与主FP4 GEMM运行在相同的张量核心上。我们提出BiLoCo，一种低秩校正方法，其左因子和右因子以二值{±1}符号向量而非BF16数字的形式存储。这种符号格式使每个秩一分量的存储减少16倍，并且由于校正现在仅由加法/减法组成，因此可以在CUDA核心上与FP4张量核心GEMM并行运行。在4B–72B规模的LLM上，
tldr: 提出BiLoCo方法，将低秩校正的左右因子以二值±1符号向量存储，每个秩一分量节省16倍存储，并可在CUDA核心上与FP4张量核心GEMM并行运行，有效缓解FP4训练后量化的精度损失。
